tools.name: continuity_audit
tools.title: continuity audit
tools.description: Retrieve locked canon for the assistant to compare against a short proposed scene. This tool supplies evidence; the assistant must identify contradictions. Does not save or approve the scene.

tools.name: create_story_project
tools.title: create story project
tools.description: Create a new private story project when the user asks. Does not save canon or scenes.

tools.name: get_canon_history
tools.title: get canon history
tools.description: Read previous and new content for a saved canon entry, newest first. No changes are made.

tools.name: get_continuity_context
tools.title: get continuity context
tools.description: Retrieve relevant canon, recent approved scenes, and the latest provisional checkpoint before continuing a saved story or recovering it in a new chat. request is a brief scene/topic query, never a chat transcript. Results are a selection; use search_story_canon for specific missing facts.

tools.name: list_approved_scenes
tools.title: list approved scenes
tools.description: Read approved scene summaries in story order. Page with offset to inspect older scenes or verify a scene number before saving.

tools.name: list_story_checkpoints
tools.title: list story checkpoints
tools.description: Retrieve provisional story handoffs to recover progress across chats. These notes never override approved canon. Page with offset for older checkpoints.

tools.name: list_story_projects
tools.title: list story projects
tools.description: Find the user’s saved story projects before starting or resuming a story. Use the returned ID; do not guess projects. Page with offset.

tools.name: record_approved_scene
tools.title: record approved scene
tools.description: Store a concise summary of a scene the user has approved. Never record an unapproved draft. An occupied scene number is preserved unless replaceExisting is true and the user requested replacement. Identical retries return the saved scene.

tools.name: save_story_checkpoint
tools.title: save story checkpoint
tools.description: Preserve a concise story-session handoff when the user asks to save progress or has authorized ongoing checkpoints for this story. Stores provisional notes, not canon or an approved scene. Separate established progress from unresolved ideas. Send only focused story state, never a full transcript, credentials, or unrelated personal details. Reuse checkpointId on retries.

tools.name: search_story_canon
tools.title: search story canon
tools.description: Search saved canon by literal title/content text, or browse every entry with an empty query and offset. Use to verify details before revising an entry or when context retrieval omits something.

tools.name: upsert_canon_entry
tools.title: upsert canon entry
tools.description: Save a fact or revise canon only after the user approves it. Preserve the existing title/kind. LOCKED requires approval as established fact; brainstorming is not approval. Existing entries require expectedRevision from retrieval; conflicting edits fail without overwriting. Identical retries leave revision history unchanged.

canon.description: false marks a temporary, alternate, or what-if entry as non-canon. Omit to keep the current value; new entries default to canon.

expiresAt.description: Optional ISO 8601 date or datetime after which a non-canon or temporary entry expires. Omit to keep, null to clear.
